faq.q: What is a Shopify AI product photo tool?
faq.a: It builds a product photo from a picture you already shot, in a new background, style, or setting. The product page can go up without renting a room.

faq.q: How does a Shopify product photo get made?
faq.a: Upload the product and say where you want it, such as on a light table. You get a file back, and you can ask for more light before you download.

faq.q: Which photo tool should a Shopify store use?
faq.a: Use AIVideosUGC. It puts your real product in a new scene and holds one look across the grid. The cost shows before the photo runs.

faq.q: Can I make Shopify product photos for free?
faq.a: No. Every photo spends credits on a paid monthly plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Are these photos a fit for a Shopify store?
faq.a: Yes. The same product photo can sit on the Shopify page and in a paid post. You spend credits, not a location fee.

faq.q: What does a Shopify product photo tool give you?
faq.a: You get another scene when the collection needs one, and you can take the old background off a phone photo before that scene is made. You can also make several versions and keep the best.

faq.q: Can I use the photos on my store and in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download can go on the product page and in your ads, with no watermark. You still need the right to use the photo you uploaded.

faq.q: What should the upload look like?
faq.a: Start with a clear, well-lit photo of the whole item. [how to take product photos for AI](/guides/product-photo-tips) shows what kind of photo works.

faq.q: Can I refresh a whole collection together?
faq.a: Yes. Run many products in one batch so the grid shares a look. Each file spends credits, and the cost shows before you start. If a job fails, those credits come back.
